resources.string: Locally adapts DNS bootstrap, handshake grace and route verification to each protocol/transport. No cloud AI and no config secrets leave the device.
Chooses bounded TLS Hello fragmentation for compatible TCP transports and avoids WireGuard, Hysteria, mKCP and proxy chains.
Manual mode is validated and bounded before it reaches Xray.
Cross-checks VPN routes, VPN/physical DNS, IPv4/IPv6 coverage and independent exit paths, then hardens DNS/routing and reconnects when a repair is needed.
